Tuple Login Instructions:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If your browser does not open automatically, go to the following URL and login:

    https://production.tuple.app/start?code_challenge=2d2501bc9ede3bcccba5856133cf8f5ba2cdde971a9c1dcbb431e424cf822a57&onboarding_origin=app&os=linux

After logging in, copy the "authorization code" and run:

    tuple auth AUTHORIZATION_CODE
